ops.title: ship-ci-rollup handoff: ship CI verdict reads the PR status rollup
ops.body:
Lane ship-ci-rollup, brief /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/meta-desk-3/b/ship-ci-rollup.md. Repo yasyf/cc-context, worktree /Users/yasyf/repos/claude/worktrees/cc-context/ship-ci-rollup (branch ship-ci-rollup, from origin/main ce6e5292). Gitignored wasm inputs copied from ~/Code/cc-context so go build works; never commit them.

Done, uncommitted at 12:03 PM Nov 6:
- internal/cli/ship.go: shipAwaitChecks is no longer a var; it returns (prstate.PR, prCIReport, error), following the shared PR cache until the head reaches pr watch --until ci's verdict (prWatchChecks + prWatchCIState, 1-minute register window), with prProveRedundantSkips on green; pending keeps waiting. New seam var shipPRCache (returns store.Read); shipOpenPR shared by shipPRHead. reportCIRuns: rollup red -> CI failure; await error -> CI error (old fallback to Actions-only removed); unproven skip -> CI unconfirmed; shipExternalChecks adds `context · state · url` lines for StatusContexts and non-Actions CheckRuns. shipChecksSettled removed.
- vcsprwatch.go: prWatchChecks extracted from prWatchSnapshotOf.
- Tests: TestShipCIVerdictIsTheHeadsStatusRollup (red / pending then red / both green) and TestShipAwaitChecks replacing TestShipChecksSettled; TestMain stubs shipPRCache.
- Docs: plugin/skills/ccx/SKILL.md ship section, AGENTS.md lines 160/234.
- go build, go vet, golangci-lint on ./internal/cli: clean.

Remaining: CHANGELOG Unreleased Fixed entry, slop-cop on SKILL.md, re-run step-one ccn answer searches, commit, open PR via open-pr express, wait for CI green, `ccx vcs merge <n> -R yasyf/cc-context --admin --match-head-commit <sha>`, cci post --kind landed --to meta-desk-3,install-desk, SendMessage meta-desk-3. Never post --kind done.
